sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Rajendra And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Public Work Deptt., Civil Secrt. Lko.

And  Counsel for Petitioner :- Brijesh Kumar Yadav,Rakesh Kumar Yadav Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Varun Pandey Hon'ble Rajan Roy,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.

Heard Shri Brijesh Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Nishant Shukla, learned Standing Counsel for the State and Shri S.B. Pandey, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Shri Varun Pandey, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 4.

On 03.03.2023 the Court had passed the following order:-
"List this case on 15.03.2023 as fresh to enable learned Counsel representing the respondents to seek instructions as to under what circumstances, as narrated in the writ petition, the land of petitioners has been utilized without either acquiring or purchasing and without paying compensation thereof."
Rajendra And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Public ...

entities.text: Rajendra And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Public
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Nishant Shukla, learned Standing Counsel informed the Court on the basis of instructions that in fact the land bearing Gata No. 309 measuring 0.893 hectares was acquired as per Notification issued under Section 11 and 19 and Award in respect thereof has been rendered on 15.12.2022 itself.
There is a dispute between the petitioners and one Devata Deen S/o Jagannath

, therefore, once the same is resolved the undisputed amount shall be remitted to the rightful persons or such other process as may be permissible and required under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, shall be adhered.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
We find from the Khatauni pertaining to Gata No. 309 that it is recorded as 'Naveen Parti'.
Petitioners claim to have been granted 'Patta' of the said land.
In any case, without entering into this issue any further, in view of what has been stated by the learned Standing Counsel the remedy for the petitioners is elsewhere and not before this Court.
They may avail such remedies as may be prescribed in the Act, 2013 or otherwise in law.

With the aforesaid observations, the writ petition is disposed of.
.

(Manish Kumar,J.) (Rajan Roy,J.) Order Date :- 15.3.2023 R.K.P.
